title: Integrate task loop into specialist pool
description: Replace direct specialist spawn in specialist-pool.service.ts with taskLoopService.executeWithLoop(). Preserve existing process-level retry for crashes. Task loop handles logical failures.
acceptance_criteria: All specialist tasks execute through task loop
Process crashes still handled by existing retry logic
Quality gate failures handled by task loop
Events forwarded to IPC for UI updates
Non-code tasks (docs, config) skip quality gates
